title: Start service over valid SendRRData
purpose: Exercise CIP service code 0x06 within a correct SendRRData and CPF envelope to reach explicit-message service dispatch.
expected_behavior: The receiver should accept the encapsulation and CPF framing and then handle or reject the Start service request at CIP level rather than failing outer parsing.
constraints_preserved: Encapsulation length matches the 24 bytes after the header.
Interface handle and timeout are present before CPF.
CPF item_count is 2 with documented Null Address Item and Unconnected Data Item ordering.
Unconnected item length is 8 and matches the CIP bytes.
Service code 0x06 is the documented Start service.
issue_safety_notes: The seed stays within documented framing and uses a compact service request for safe initial coverage.
